snippet.title: XYLOMETAZOLINE - OFFICIAL GAME TRAILER
snippet.description:
WARNING: This trailer contains flashing lights that may affect viewers who are sensitive to light or have photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised.

XYLOMETAZOLINE IS COMING 15.05.2026

WISHLIST ON STEAM: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/45...

FOLLOW ON ITCH.IO: 
https://wozprod.itch.io/xylometazoline

FOLLOW ON GAMEJOLT:
https://gamejolt.com/games/xylometazo...

____________________________________________
XYLOMETAZOLINE is a surreal, first-person narrative experience rooted in the PSX-horror aesthetic. It explores the harrowing struggle of addictions that regulate both the physical and emotional state, portrayed through a dependency on nasal drops. It is a philosophical journey through a world where every living being is hooked on something, and the line between substance and habit has blurred into an existential nightmare.

You play as Nobody - a faceless, shadow-like figure sitting in a dimly lit apartment in a decaying, post-communist block. Your life is a cycle of catastrophic news on TV and the constant need to breathe. When a mysterious car accident leaves a package for a stranger's "daughter" in your hands, you are thrust into a journey through brutalist estates, the abandoned offices of the XYLOLIFE corporation, and liminal spaces where architecture itself is built from addiction.

Take care of your sanity to stay sane, and it won't be easy - addiction constantly reminds you of itself.

Wander through surreal and dark corridors and try not to lose yourself in it all. A unique, atmospheric, and well-soundtracked journey through the deepest recesses of the human mind awaits you. Will you take control of your addiction, or is it already controlling you?
